title: Replicate API token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39-character token (36-character body) vs the documented 40-character total and length: 41-character token (38-character body) vs the documented 40-character total. Twin of "Replicate API token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of replicate-api-token-bearer-header: length: 41-character token (38-character body) vs the documented 40-character total. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
